verdict.rationale: Obsidian's own docs describe an official headless Sync client that runs without the desktop app and is pitched for CI pipelines, agents and automated workflows. That is a first-party, non-GUI interface suited to AI-native use, but it covers only vault syncing, and the snippet never confirms it is a command-line tool or describes its commands. The Obsidian URI protocol is an adjacent trigger mechanism, not a CLI, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented CLI with commands beyond sync (reading, searching, creating or editing notes), a command reference or install docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
